name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans, driven through the user's jianying-headless fork unmodified: multi-track video/text/audio with transitions, keyframes, masks, narration condensing, and native MP4 export. Pinned to macOS JianYing 11.4.x.

interface.shortDescription: jy14 plans to native JianYing drafts
interface.longDescription: Native JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans via the unmodified jianying-headless fork: multi-track video/text/audio, transitions/keyframes/masks, narration condensing, native export.

skillInstructions: 加载本插件技能时：生成草稿前先跑 headless_draft.py doctor 确认 fork 检出与剪映 11.4.x 环境；已有草稿永不覆盖，发布需剪映完全关闭。
